title: Valued term associated to a constraint
statement: A constraint determines a valued term whose arity is the arity of its predicate, whose cost function is that predicate’s unsatisfied-cost function, and whose variables are the constraint’s ordered scope.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint from a fixed predicate template and variable type
caveat: The formal statement relies on the imported definition of a valued term and the template’s unsatisfied-cost function, neither of which is included in the supplied upstream definitions.
